```sql
SELECT 
    e.FirstName, 
    e.LastName, 
    COUNT(Customer.CustomerId) AS NumberOfCustomers
FROM 
    Employee e
JOIN 
    Customer c ON e.SupportRepId = c.SupportRepId
GROUP BY 
    e.FirstName, e.LastName
```
